decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX extends the firm's established trommel screening know-how, so the firm can read market feedback well and keep refining it.
Mobile flail shredders build closely on the firm's mobile comminution competence and own development, so the line can be improved from what the firm learns.
The high-speed grinder line draws on related mobile grinding knowledge, though low visibility and overlap with the withdrawn green-waste grinder leave some risk of consolidation.

The stationary electric fine shredder sits further from the mobile core and is barely visible, but it supports the strategic build-up of plant-based knowledge, so keeping it remains justified for now.
The single-shaft pre-shredders build on core shredding expertise and support the stationary plant strategy, giving the firm strong capacity to assimilate results and improve them.
